OER Floor Mount Headlamp Dimmer Switch

For 1961-1984 GM Models

The headlight dimmer switch is located on the drivers front floor and used to switch the headlights from low beam to high beam. This reproduction switch is correct for various GM models which were equipped with a floor mount dimmer switch.
